fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local political commentary on proposed legalization and expansion of gambling in Dade County; criticism of the Greater Miami Crime Commission’s tactics and its impact on local officials; discussion of Miami governance issues including control of Biscayne Bay property, water-rate authority, and rent control politics in Miami Beach. Reports and commentary address alleged judicial and political influence in a divorce case (Jacobson v. Jacobson) involving Circuit Judge Ross Williams and attorneys; notes on Miami municipal and county courts and calls for grand jury activity; an open letter concerning Miami Transit Company and bus-riding citizens; coverage of police handling of minor offenses and alleged police cruelty; and civic/business items including requests to deepen the Florida Intracoastal Waterway and expand yacht/dock facilities (Dinner Key and other projects). Health-related commentary includes emergency medical access and cancer check-up advocacy, alongside discussion of spiritualist mediums.
